Add.desc: Adds A and B; an unconnected input uses its ConstA or ConstB value.

Constant.desc: Outputs the scalar value stored in R.

Constant2Vector.desc: Outputs a two-component constant formed from R and G, followed by separate R and G component outputs.

Constant3Vector.desc: Outputs a three-component constant formed from Constant.RGB, followed by separate R, G, and B component outputs.

Custom.desc: Embeds user HLSL in a generated material function with property-defined dynamic inputs and outputs.
Custom.notes: Inputs and outputs are dynamic. RebuildOutputs creates one unnamed output without AdditionalOutputs, otherwise 'return' followed by named outputs. Pin LinkedTo records own connections; FCustomInput.Input is reconstructed. UE 5.8 defaults are Description='Custom', OutputType=CMOT_Float3, and one unnamed input. Material IR permits at most 32 named inputs plus named additional outputs. The LumaSplit fixture has generated paste/copy-back evidence.

Multiply.desc: Multiplies A and B; an unconnected input uses its ConstA or ConstB value.
